items.name: Splintered Cudgel
items.flavor: It was a fencepost once. It remembers.

items.name: Reedwoven Vest
items.flavor: Reeds woven twice. The marsh respects politeness.

items.name: Tallow Charm
items.flavor: Smells of old chapels and older candles.

items.name: Chipped Bell Hammer
items.flavor: Standard issue for the Bellbound. The chip is traditional.

items.name: Pilgrim's Coat
items.flavor: Twelve mendings, twelve roads.

items.name: Knot-and-Bone
items.flavor: A knot for every promise kept. It has never been untied.

items.name: Marsh Reaver
items.flavor: Cut from a punt pole that outran the flood.

items.name: Verdigris Hauberk
items.flavor: Bronze gone green. The green is the strength.

items.name: Tollkeeper's Iron
items.flavor: Honest iron for honest tolls.

items.name: Waders of the Low Road
items.flavor: Dry feet, deeper nerve.

items.name: Pewter Vesper
items.flavor: A small evening prayer, cast in soft metal.

items.name: Sexton's Crook
items.special_text: Wounds no longer silence your Echo. It falls to half instead.
items.flavor: The sexton's last tool. It still knows the work.

items.name: Ashveil Mantle
items.special_text: Expeditions take a quarter less time. The ash thickens: +1 danger.
items.flavor: Sewn from the quiet hour.

items.name: Wayfarer's Rosary
items.special_text: +1 Luck for every toll completed on the road.
items.flavor: One bead per road. The string is long.

items.name: Tithemaker
items.special_text: Every enemy slain pays one Ashen Shard.
items.flavor: The bell counts. The bell collects.

items.name: Censer of the Low Road
items.special_text: Luck doubled — and the bell cannot call them home before the last toll.
items.flavor: Smoke goes where it pleases. So will they.

items.name: Deepseeker's Maul
items.flavor: Weighted for the bottom of things.

items.name: Choirplate
items.flavor: Armor that hums when struck. It knows the hymn.

items.name: The Unmarked Grave
items.special_text: If they fall, half the expedition's findings come home anyway.
items.flavor: No name. No stone. No loss.

items.name: Widow's Knell
items.special_text: Each Echo grants +2 Might instead of +1. Silence lasts longer.
items.flavor: Rung once, at a funeral the valley still remembers.

items.name: The Gravecho's Tongue
items.special_text: The first enemy of every toll is already struck down.
items.flavor: Cut from the dead bell's voice. It still wants to speak.
